rows.label: bf08450100_0010
rows.name: Warrior monks of the [System:Ruby rt=Acedia ]Holy See[/System:Ruby].

rows.label: bf08450100_0020
rows.name:
So you're Heaven's Holy Grail and her Driver?
I have orders to relay from His Holiness Malbeni.

rows.label: bf08450100_0030
rows.name:
Use the power of Heaven's Holy Grail
to shoot down that ship right now.

rows.label: bf08450100_0050
rows.name:
What's the matter? That's
supposed to be your duty.

rows.label: bf08450100_0060
rows.name:
My duty is to open the
way to the World Tree.

rows.label: bf08450100_0070
rows.name: Are you refusing to do it?

rows.label: bf08450100_0080
rows.name: In that case, hand that person over to us.

rows.label: bf08450100_0100
rows.name:
So that's your scheme: use Hikari's power
to burn it all down and be done with it?

rows.label: bf08450100_0120
rows.name:
I never said we couldn't
do it. Tell Malbeni that.

rows.label: bf08450100_0130
rows.name: We'll be the ones to stop Shin. So...

rows.label: bf08450100_0140
rows.name:
We don't have time to
stand here arguing.

rows.label: bf08450100_0150
rows.name:
If you won't obey, then we
will take you by force.
